name: TSDF Reconstruction from Depth Maps
definition: Converts per-surfel depth outputs into a unified 3D mesh by computing a robust depth value per pixel and fusing the resulting depth maps via TSDF.
summary: TSDF Reconstruction from Depth Maps converts per-surfel depth outputs into a unified 3D mesh by fusing depth maps via Truncated Signed Distance Function fusion, differing from neural rendering by relying on explicit geometric fusion.
